en: The image shows an old, grand building almost entirely covered in green ivy, with large windows and ornate architectural details. The structure is likely from the late 19th or early 20th century, with a symmetrical façade and decorative stonework above the entrance. In front of the building is a formal garden with white geometric sculptures or benches, well-maintained lawns, and a few people walking or standing near the entrance. The scene is bathed in soft, warm light, giving the image a nostalgic feel.
